name: exit_verify
description: Check what websites see through a home exit: its public IP compared with the VPS's, whether the network looks residential or datacenter (best-effort hint), where DNS is resolved, and the timezone a browser should use. It checks the exit itself, not the routing rules or a client's proxy settings; a report with inconclusive=true could not measure the IP or DNS comparison. Takes a few seconds. Read-only.

exit.description: Exit to check; omit to check all.
